newsitem.title: FRANCE: Still no decision on Airjet 70 launch.
newsitem.headline: Still no decision on Airjet 70 launch.

text.p: Aero International (Regional) has not yet decided whether to launch a 70-seater Airjet programme, AI(R) president Patrick Gavin said on Monday at the Paris airshow.
"There will be no announcement at Le Bourget on the choice of engines for the Airjet or on the launch decision," Gavin told a news conference. "We prefer to continue our studies."
AI(R) is a venture in which Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc and Alenia participate. It markets the Avro RJ jet and the ATR turboprop built by Aerospatial and Finmemeccanica's Alenia unit.
Gavin's comments repeated statements made on June 8 by Aerospatial chairman Yves Michot.
"What is certain is that at the moment we have not decided to invest the resources of our house in a new regional plane project," Michot said.
